_comment: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE — not a recording of any site.
Reproduces GET /at-home/server/{chapterId}: a short-lived image host, a
chapter hash, and the page filenames at two qualities. A page URL is
assembled as {baseUrl}/data/{hash}/{filename} for full quality, or
This is the one endpoint api.mangadex.org disallows in robots.txt, and so
the one Quire fetches as PLAN §7.4 retrieval rather than discovery. The
test asserts the request kind, not just the URLs.
Why synthetic: PLAN §1.3 and §1.4. The filenames here are invented and the
image host is example.invalid, so nothing in this file points at content.
Deliberate variations exercised by the test:
- baseUrl carries a trailing slash, which must not produce a double one
- dataSaver lists the same pages as .jpg, and must be ignored: M4
re-encodes for the device anyway, so starting from an already
recompressed JPEG would compound the loss
- one empty filename, which must be skipped rather than yielding a URL
